params.text: The Suez Canal was opened in eighteen sixty-nine, after ten years of construction. It runs for one hundred and twenty miles, linking the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea, and it removed the need for ships to travel around the whole of Africa.

attributions_required: Voice synthesised with Piper using the LibriTTS-R voice (CC BY 4.0).

kill_evidence: Factual error rate too high to verify economically
open_questions: TTS engine adequate for flat long-form delivery (bar is lower here)
